name: Yeoman’s Prophecy
body:
Yeoman’s Prophecy

School divination [air, water]; Level adept 2, druid 3, hunter 3, shaman 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (a scale from a pine cone)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 24 hours

Observing the clouds above you, you gain insight into the patterns of wind and water, earth and sky, and how you can work in harmony with them. Choose a Profession skill based on outdoor work, such as farming or fishing. For the next 24 hours, when seasonal or weather conditions would impose a penalty to such skill checks, the penalties are reduced by 4. This also applies on Constitution checks to continue working and avoid fatigue, and on saving throws against harsh weather or climate.

If planting, tending or harvesting crops, you need to spend only 6 hours each day to make normal progress, rather than 8 hours.

If you are caring for livestock, mounts or beasts of burden, you also reduce any penalties on skill checks made to tend to your herds, and to notice pests or predators that threaten them.

While you work, you can advise a number of other intelligent creatures equal to your ranks in the chosen Profession skill, allowing them to share these benefits. The creatures must be able to see and hear you at regular intervals to benefit from your advice.

The benefits of this spell only apply to your work, not to skill checks or saving throws made for other reasons.
